review_method: Static review of the supplied repaired source before tests or execution, retaining the accepted scheduler and qa.execute lifecycle.
findings: The worker derives the teacher target from the native transport head’s emitted logits minus its fixed bias. The saved attention and logits come from that same forward pass.

The primal verifier uses the LP’s K-major indexing and checks each row’s normalized error. The dual uses the correct separator sign and reverses row scaling before exact verification. Both classifications compare exact rational bounds with 1e-7. The reported float bounds round outward, and inconclusive cases remain unresolved.

The parent checks the frozen 96 indices and their three shards before launch, then verifies case coverage and private witness hashes before sealing the result. The unit entry point now checks output freshness before writing any artifact.
claim_scope: A positive gate requires K1 separation and a K8 approximate match on the same passage. It supports only that fixed-frame, per-passage oracle distinction and carries no L5 claim.
